index_range.description: Conditional mathematical index range, distinct from its definition. Unbounded is explicit, never null/unknown or a nonfinite JSON number. Only reviewed family ranges are admitted.

hydrostatic_compressibility_contract.description: Closed hydrostatic-stress science: fixed-tensor spectral range is distinct from unrestricted tensor-class range; no evaluator.

const.equality_condition: beta_min=beta_max iff B=(kappa/3)*I; hydrostatic-response isotropy does not imply full elastic isotropy

engineering_convention_audit.orthotropic_specialization: g4=g5=g6=0 in the symmetry frame; diagonal-only formula is not general for lower symmetry
engineering_convention_audit.tensor_shear_warning: S_eng_44=4*S2323; S_eng_41=2*S2311; full tensor contractions automatically include both index orders
engineering_convention_audit.basis_warning: Crystallographic lattice vectors need not be orthogonal; the triad identity requires orthonormal Cartesian unit directions.

NLC along n means that sum exceeds 1; do not confuse beta with a Poisson ratio or copy the different Miller subscript convention.

const.symmetry_warning: Unboundedness over the unrestricted tensor class is not unboundedness in every symmetry class. Full-SPD cubic and isotropic elasticity have r(n)=1/3 for every n.

class_definitions.complete_monotonicity: (-1)^n R^(n)(t)>=0 for every integer n>=0 and every t>0
class_definitions.bernstein: J>=0 and J_prime is completely monotone on t>0
class_definitions.weak_monotonicity: R is nonincreasing; J is nondecreasing

causal_conventions.constitutive_laws: sigma=R*D(epsilon); epsilon=J*D(sigma), with causal distributional derivatives including initial jumps
causal_conventions.initial_creep_jump: D(HJ)=J0*delta_0+H(t)*J_prime(t); HJ denotes pointwise causal extension
causal_conventions.newtonian_caution: N=0 excludes an additive relaxation impulse, not every dashpot; the Maxwell series dashpot is admitted

finite_interval_regularity.bernstein_representation: J(t)=J0+b*t+integral_(0,infinity) (1-exp(-r*t)) nu(dr); b>=0; integral min(1,r) nu(dr)<infinity
finite_interval_regularity.integrable_derivative: For every finite T>0, Tonelli gives integral_0^T J_prime(s) ds=b*T+integral (1-exp(-r*T)) nu(dr)=J(T)-J0<infinity
finite_interval_regularity.absolute_continuity: J(t)=J0+integral_0^t J_prime(s) ds, so J is absolutely continuous on every [0,T]
finite_interval_regularity.differentiation: R is continuous on [0,T]; write R*J=J0*integral_0^t R(u) du+integral_0^t (R*J_prime)(u) du. The latter convolution is continuous, so 1=J0*R(t)+(R*J_prime)(t) for every t>0

endpoint_limits.positive_equilibrium_modulus: If Rinf>0 then Jinf=1/Rinf and lim_(t->infinity) R(t)*J(t)=1
endpoint_limits.zero_equilibrium_modulus: If Rinf=0 then Jinf=infinity; no universal product limit is inferred from 0 times infinity
